evidenceBoundary.freshness: This is an inspection snapshot, not a revision-bound implementation or runtime receipt. No drift was observed by the inspection tools, but read/hash atomicity and subsequent lead edits are not guaranteed. Before applying any request, rehash and reread changed files on the wave0 commit; invalidate affected line evidence rather than reusing it silently.

evidenceBoundary.execution: No builds, product tests, native UI, network operations, Git changes or product/source edits performed. Only this report is written. All behavior verification below is proposed, not executed.
evidenceBoundary.uninspected: Service composition root, concrete transport principal implementation, task persistence implementation, project detail route consumer and agent tool dispatchers outside the package/direct imports were not inspected. Their exact accepted interfaces must come from owners, not guessed symbols.
